    printf -- '- **kubectl exec:** psql runs only in the test'"'"'s own client pod `%s`, never in a Postgres pod (D4)\n' "$CLIENT"
    printf '\n## Checks\n\n| Check | Result |\n|---|---|\n'; cat "$CHECKS"; cat "$BODY"; } | redact > "$EV_FILE"
  log "RESULT L1: $verdict -> docs/evidence/L1-replication.md"
  [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ]
}

# q HOST USER SQL: one psql call from the client pod. The password is chosen inside the pod from its env.
q() {
  kubectl -n "$NS" exec "$CLIENT" -- sh -c '
    case "$2" in app) PGPASSWORD=$APP_PW ;; monitor) PGPASSWORD=$MON_PW ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac; export PGPASSWORD
    exec psql "host=$1 user=$2 dbname=app connect_timeout=5" -XAtq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -F " " -c "$3"' sh "$1" "$2" "$3"
}
RW=pg-rw.$NS.svc.cluster.local; RO=pg-ro.$NS.svc.cluster.local
member() { echo "$1.pg-headless.$NS.svc.cluster.local"; }
cluster_json() { patroni_cluster; }
leader() { cluster_json | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .name'; }
pod_ip() { kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$1" -o jsonpath='{.status.podIP}'; }

kubectl get ns "$NS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "namespace $NS not found, run: make up"
patroni_healthy || die "Patroni is not healthy, see: make status"

section "Setup: test client pod (our image, Pod Security restricted)"
kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$CLIENT" --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|" <<'YAML' | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: pg-test-client, labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: pg-test-client}}
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 999, runAsGroup: 999, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
  containers:
  - name: client
    image: __PG_IMAGE__
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    command: [sleep, "1800"]
    securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
    env:
    - {name: HOME, value: /tmp}
    - name: APP_PW
      valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: pg-credentials, key: pg-app-password}}
    - name: MON_PW
      valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: pg-credentials, key: pg-monitor-password}}
    volumeMounts: [{name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}]
  volumes: [{name: tmp, emptyDir: {}}]
YAML
kubectl -n "$NS" wait --for=condition=Ready "pod/$CLIENT" --timeout=60s >/dev/null || die "client pod not ready"

section "Topology (T:topology)"
run "patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | \"\(.name) role=\(.role) state=\(.state) timeline=\(.timeline) lag=\(.lag // \"-\")\"'"
run "kubectl -n $NS get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pg -o custom-columns=POD:.metadata.name,NODE:.spec.nodeName,IP:.status.podIP,ROLE:.metadata.labels.role,READY:.status.containerStatuses[0].ready"
J=$(cluster_json); L=$(leader); LIP=$(pod_ip "$L")
REPLICAS=$(jq -r '.members[] | select(.role != "leader") | .name' <<<"$J" | tr '\n' ' ')
check "Patroni: exactly 1 leader" test "$(jq '[.members[] | select(.role == "leader" and .state == "running")] | length' <<<"$J")" = 1
check "Patroni: exactly 2 streaming replicas" test "$(jq '[.members[] | select(.role != "leader" and .state == "streaming")] | length' <<<"$J")" = 2
check "Patroni: exactly 1 synchronous standby" test "$(jq '[.members[] | select(.role == "sync_standby")] | length' <<<"$J")" = 1
nodes=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/name=pg -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.nodeName}{"\n"}{end}')
check "Placement: 3 members on 3 distinct agent nodes (R7.4)" bash -c "[ \$(sort -u <<<'$nodes' | grep -c agent) = 3 ]"
for m in $L $REPLICAS; do
  echo "$m: $(q "$(member "$m")" monitor "select 'version_num=' || current_setting('server_version_num') || ' in_recovery=' || pg_is_in_recovery() || ' checksums=' || current_setting('data_checksums') || ' ssl=' || current_setting('ssl')")"
done > /tmp/l1-members.$$ 2>&1
run "cat /tmp/l1-members.$$"
check "Every member runs Postgres >= 15 (R1.1)" bash -c "[ \$(grep -cE 'version_num=(1[5-9]|[2-9][0-9])[0-9]{4}' /tmp/l1-members.$$) = 3 ]"
check "Exactly 1 member not in recovery, 2 in recovery (R1.2)" bash -c "[ \$(grep -c 'in_recovery=false' /tmp/l1-members.$$) = 1 ] && [ \$(grep -c 'in_recovery=true' /tmp/l1-members.$$) = 2 ]"
check "Data checksums and server TLS on every member" bash -c "[ \$(grep -c 'checksums=on ssl=on' /tmp/l1-members.$$) = 3 ]"
rm -f /tmp/l1-members.$$

section "Streaming and the synchronous standby (T:replication)"
REPL_SQL="select application_name, state, sync_state from pg_stat_replication order by application_name"
run "q $RW monitor \"$REPL_SQL\""
R=$(q "$RW" monitor "$REPL_SQL")
check "pg_stat_replication on the primary: 2 rows streaming (R1.3)" test "$(grep -c ' streaming ' <<<"$R")" = 2
check "pg_stat_replication: exactly 1 sync and 1 async standby" bash -c "[ \$(grep -c ' sync\$' <<<'$R') = 1 ] && [ \$(grep -c ' async\$' <<<'$R') = 1 ]"
SYNC=$(jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "sync_standby") | .name' <<<"$J")
check "Postgres and Patroni agree on the sync standby ($SYNC)" grep -q "^$SYNC streaming sync\$" <<<"$R"
run "q $RW monitor \"select name, setting from pg_settings where name in ('synchronous_commit','synchronous_standby_names') order by name\""

section "Write through pg-rw, read through pg-ro and on each replica"
TOKEN="l1-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$RANDOM"
q "$RW" app "create table if not exists l1_marker (token text primary key, written_at timestamptz default now())" >/dev/null
run "q $RW app \"insert into l1_marker(token) values ('$TOKEN') returning token, written_at\""
seen_ro=0; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(q "$RO" app "select count(*) from l1_marker where token = '$TOKEN'")" = 1 ] && { seen_ro=1; break; }; sleep 0.5; done
check "Row written through pg-rw is readable through pg-ro" test $seen_ro = 1
for m in $REPLICAS; do
  seen=0; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do [ "$(q "$(member "$m")" app "select count(*) from l1_marker where token = '$TOKEN'")" = 1 ] && { seen=1; break; }; sleep 0.5; done
  check "Row is readable on replica $m (R1.3)" test $seen = 1
done

section "Replication lag in bytes and seconds (R1.7)"
note "Measured on the primary right after a write. \`replay_lag\` is Postgres's own time measurement and becomes NULL once a standby has been idle and caught up, so it is sampled straight after the write."
q "$RW" app "insert into l1_marker(token) values ('$TOKEN-lag')" >/dev/null
LAG_SQL="select application_name, sync_state, pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) as lag_bytes, coalesce(round(extract(epoch from replay_lag)::numeric, 6)::text, 'null') as lag_seconds from pg_stat_replication order by application_name"
run "q $RW monitor \"$LAG_SQL\""
LAG=$(q "$RW" monitor "$LAG_SQL")
check "Lag reported in bytes for both standbys" test "$(awk '$3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/' <<<"$LAG" | wc -l)" = 2
check "Lag reported in seconds for both standbys" test "$(awk '$4 ~ /^[0-9.]+$/' <<<"$LAG" | wc -l)" = 2

section "Replication slots and the WAL cap (ADR-005)"
SLOT_SQL="select slot_name, slot_type, active, wal_status, pg_size_pretty(safe_wal_size) as safe_wal_size from pg_replication_slots order by slot_name"
run "q $RW monitor \"$SLOT_SQL\""
run "q $RW monitor \"select name, setting, unit from pg_settings where name in ('max_slot_wal_keep_size','max_wal_size','wal_log_hints') order by name\""
S=$(q "$RW" monitor "select slot_name, slot_type, active, safe_wal_size is not null from pg_replication_slots")
EXPECT_SLOTS=$(for m in $REPLICAS; do echo "${m//-/_}"; done | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
check "One active physical slot per replica ($EXPECT_SLOTS)" bash -c "[ \"\$(awk '\$2==\"physical\" && \$3==\"t\" {print \$1}' <<<'$S' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')\" = '$EXPECT_SLOTS' ]"
check "max_slot_wal_keep_size is 1GB and limits every slot (safe_wal_size set)" bash -c "[ \"\$(q $RW monitor \"select current_setting('max_slot_wal_keep_size')\")\" = 1GB ] && ! awk '\$4!=\"t\"' <<<'$S' | grep -q ."
check "max_wal_size is 512MB" test "$(q "$RW" monitor "select current_setting('max_wal_size')")" = 512MB

section "Client endpoints (T:endpoints)"
RW_EP=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=pg-rw -o jsonpath='{.items[*].endpoints[*].addresses[*]}')
RO_EP=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=pg-ro -o jsonpath='{range .items[*].endpoints[?(@.conditions.ready==true)]}{.addresses[0]}{" "}{end}')
note "Leader \`$L\` has pod IP \`$LIP\`. The pg-rw EndpointSlice (mirrored from Patroni's Endpoints) lists \`$RW_EP\`. pg-ro lists \`$RO_EP\`."
run "q $RW app \"select 'pg-rw: server=' || host(inet_server_addr()) || ' in_recovery=' || pg_is_in_recovery()\""
run "q $RO app \"select 'pg-ro: server=' || host(inet_server_addr()) || ' in_recovery=' || pg_is_in_recovery()\""
check "pg-rw EndpointSlice points only at the leader ($L)" test "$RW_EP" = "$LIP"
check "pg-rw connects to the leader, not in recovery (R2.1)" test "$(q "$RW" app "select host(inet_server_addr()) || ' ' || pg_is_in_recovery()")" = "$LIP false"
check "pg-ro lists exactly the 2 replicas" test "$(tr ' ' '\n' <<<"$RO_EP" | grep -c .)" = 2
check "pg-ro connects to a replica in recovery (R2.2)" test "$(q "$RO" app "select pg_is_in_recovery()")" = t
run "q $RO app \"insert into l1_marker(token) values ('must-fail')\"" || true
check "pg-ro rejects a write (R2.2)" bash -c "! q $RO app \"insert into l1_marker(token) values ('must-fail')\""

section "Replica pod deleted: it rejoins and streams again"
VICTIM=$SYNC
note "Fault: \`kubectl delete pod $VICTIM\` (the synchronous standby). Leader before: \`$L\`, timeline $(jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline' <<<"$J")."
t0=$(date +%s.%N)
run "kubectl -n $NS delete pod $VICTIM --wait=false"
sleep 2; rejoined=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  J2=$(cluster_json || true)
  if jq -e --arg v "$VICTIM" '.members[] | select(.name == $v and .state == "streaming")' <<<"$J2" >/dev/null 2>&1 && patroni_healthy; then rejoined=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
t1=$(date +%s.%N); RJ=$(awk -v a="$t0" -v b="$t1" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", b-a}')
note "Time from delete to the member streaming again with a healthy cluster: **${RJ} s**."
run "patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | \"\(.name) role=\(.role) state=\(.state) timeline=\(.timeline) lag=\(.lag // \"-\")\"'"
J2=$(cluster_json)
check "Deleted replica $VICTIM rejoined and is streaming" test $rejoined = 1
check "Leader unchanged ($L) and timeline unchanged" test "$(jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | "\(.name) \(.timeline)"' <<<"$J2")" = "$L $(jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline' <<<"$J")"
check "After rejoin: exactly 1 sync standby" test "$(jq '[.members[] | select(.role == "sync_standby")] | length' <<<"$J2")" = 1
R2=$(q "$RW" monitor "$REPL_SQL")
run "q $RW monitor \"$REPL_SQL\""
check "After rejoin: pg_stat_replication shows 2 streaming rows including $VICTIM" bash -c "[ \$(grep -c ' streaming ' <<<'$R2') = 2 ] && grep -q '^$VICTIM streaming' <<<'$R2'"
check "After rejoin: $VICTIM has the marker row and its slot is active" bash -c "[ \"\$(q $(member "$VICTIM") app \"select count(*) from l1_marker where token = '$TOKEN'\")\" = 1 ] && [ \"\$(q $RW monitor \"select active from pg_replication_slots where slot_name = '${VICTIM//-/_}'\")\" = t ]"

finish
EOF
chmod +x tests/test-replication.sh; bash -n tests/test-replication.sh && echo syntax-ok

input.command:
python3 -I - <<'E'
p='tests/test-replication.sh'; s=open(p).read()
old='''t0=$(date +%s.%N)
run "kubectl -n $NS delete pod $VICTIM --wait=false"
sleep 2; rejoined=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
  J2=$(cluster_json || true)
  if jq -e --arg v "$VICTIM" '.members[] | select(.name == $v and .state == "streaming")' <<<"$J2" >/dev/null 2>&1 && patroni_healthy; then rejoined=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done'''
new='''OLD_UID=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$VICTIM" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}')
t0=$(date +%s.%N)
run "kubectl -n $NS delete pod $VICTIM --wait=false"
# Wait for the replacement pod (new UID) first: the old pod keeps reporting "streaming" while it shuts down.
rejoined=0; new_pod=0
for _ in $(seq 1 240); do
  if [ $new_pod = 0 ]; then
    uid=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$VICTIM" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}' 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ -n "$uid" ] && [ "$uid" != "$OLD_UID" ] && new_pod=1
  fi
  if [ $new_pod = 1 ]; then
    J2=$(cluster_json || true)
    if jq -e --arg v "$VICTIM" '.members[] | select(.name == $v and .state == "streaming")' <<<"$J2" >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
       [ "$(q "$RW" monitor "select count(*) from pg_stat_replication where application_name = '$VICTIM' and state = 'streaming'" 2>/dev/null)" = 1 ] &&
       patroni_healthy; then rejoined=1; break; fi
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('note "Time from delete to the member streaming again with a healthy cluster: **${RJ} s**."',
 'note "Time from delete until the replacement pod (new UID) streams again, seen by both Patroni and pg_stat_replication on the primary: **${RJ} s**."')
s=s.replace('check "Deleted replica $VICTIM rejoined and is streaming" test $rejoined = 1',
 'check "Deleted replica $VICTIM came back as a new pod" test $new_pod = 1\ncheck "Deleted replica $VICTIM rejoined and is streaming" test $rejoined = 1')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E

content.text:
L1 is built and passes its gate on a cluster rebuilt from scratch, and nothing is committed. The full cycle was down, up, seed, then the test. Step 0 is done as well: S3 and S4 history now live in hand-written files, and reruns of both spikes left those files byte-identical.

## L1 gate

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `make down` leaves no containers, volumes or networks, and `./secrets` is unchanged | PASS |
| `make up` from scratch, ending with a healthy Patroni cluster | PASS, 228 s |
| Second `make deploy` changes nothing (same pods, same leader) | PASS |
| `make status`: members, roles, lag in bytes, sync standby, `pg-rw`/`pg-ro` targets, no exec | PASS |
| `make seed` through `pg-rw` to the leader over SSL | PASS, 157 MB in about 13 s |
| Exactly 1 leader and 2 streaming replicas, on 3 distinct agents | PASS |
| Exactly 1 sync standby, and Patroni and Postgres agree which one | PASS |
| Postgres 17 on every member, with checksums and server TLS on | PASS |
| A write through `pg-rw` is readable through `pg-ro` and on both replicas | PASS |
| Lag reported in bytes and seconds for both standbys | PASS |
| One active slot per replica, and the 1 GB cap is in effect | PASS |
| `pg-rw` points only at the leader; `pg-ro` serves replicas and rejects writes | PASS |
| A deleted replica comes back and streams again, with the leader unchanged and 1 sync standby | PASS, 9–10 s to rejoin |

The test results are in `docs/evidence/L1-replication.md`. The rejoin check first passed falsely, because it accepted the old pod while it was still shutting down. I fixed the test to wait for the replacement pod, and the final runs measured 9.4 s and 10.3 s.

**Time:** about 17 minutes (16:47 to 17:04 UTC) against the 2.5 h estimate.

**Resources with Postgres running and seeded:** the cluster's containers use about 1.4 GiB of RAM, and the host uses 2.3 of 15.6 GiB. Disk use is 11 of 48 GB, of which Docker volumes are 4.2 GB.

**One unplanned command:** while measuring resources, I ran a no-op `docker exec … true` on the three agent containers. It changed nothing and no result depends on it, but it was outside the committed scripts.

## What changes L2

1. **Config changes move the leader.** Any change to the Patroni config restarts every pod in turn, including the leader, which causes a leader change. It happened once here, without errors. L2 should not measure failover timing across a deploy, and planned changes may need a switchover first.
2. **Patroni can report a dying pod as streaming.** The L2 failure tests must wait for the new pod and confirm on the primary, not trust Patroni's view alone.
3. **The leader lock lives in the `pg-rw` Endpoints object.** It is deliberately not in the manifests, so re-deploying never overwrites it. The split-brain test should read the lock holder from there.
4. **`make status` depends on the Kubernetes API.** It reads Patroni through the API server, so it goes blind during the API-outage scenario. That test needs another way to see the cluster.
5. **Small things left for later:**
   - The access rules hard-code the k3s pod network range.
   - Patroni's REST API has no authentication yet, so L2 switchovers could use it until L6.
   - When the sync standby is deleted, the other replica takes over sync as designed.

The new pieces are `deploy/pg/`, `scripts/deploy.sh`, `scripts/seed.sh`, `tests/test-replication.sh`, and changes to `Makefile`, `scripts/lib.sh` and `scripts/status.sh`. A scan found no credential values and no floating image tags in the repo. Nothing is committed.

   reach replicas. Prove from the probe and from Postgres that the old primary stops
   acknowledging writes before a new leader is elected, and measure the demotion time against
   the 13s bound + 7s stop budget (ADR-006).

The first from-scratch run failed 2 of its checks. An earlier pass that reported an 8.6 s rejoin was probably the same false positive. The test now waits for a new pod UID and confirms streaming from `pg_stat_replication` on the primary. Two consecutive runs then passed every check, with rejoin times of 9.4 s and 10.3 s.

```console
$ for n in 0 1 2; do docker exec k3d-pg-ha-agent-$n true 2>/dev/null; done
```

p='tests/test-replication.sh'; s=open(p).read()

"""+old
assert old in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new,1))

open(p,'w').write(s)
E

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared helpers for tests. Sources the spike evidence helpers (redact, run, check, note, section).
#
# kubectl exec (D4): tests run psql only inside their own client pod, pg-test-client, never in a
# Postgres pod. Fault scripts may use docker exec on a k3d node, and each use is documented where it runs.
. "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../scripts/spikes/lib.sh"
NS=$PG_NS; CLIENT=pg-test-client
BODY=$(mktemp); CHECKS=$(mktemp); FAILS=0; T0=$SECONDS; STARTED=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
RW=pg-rw.$NS.svc.cluster.local; RO=pg-ro.$NS.svc.cluster.local
member() { echo "$1.pg-headless.$NS.svc.cluster.local"; }
now() { date +%s.%N; }
iso() { date -u -d "@$1" +%H:%M:%S.%3N; }
secs() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN{ if (a == "" || b == "") print "n/a"; else printf "%.2f", b - a }'; }

# q HOST USER SQL: one psql call from the client pod. The password is chosen inside the pod from its env.
q() {
  kubectl -n "$NS" exec "$CLIENT" -- sh -c '
    case "$2" in app) PGPASSWORD=$APP_PW ;; monitor) PGPASSWORD=$MON_PW ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac; export PGPASSWORD
    exec psql "host=$1 user=$2 dbname=app connect_timeout=3" -XAtq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -F " " -c "$3"' sh "$1" "$2" "$3"
}
export -f q; export NS CLIENT

client_up() {
  kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$CLIENT" >/dev/null 2>&1 && kubectl -n "$NS" wait --for=condition=Ready "pod/$CLIENT" --timeout=5s >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$CLIENT" --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
  sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|" <<'YAML' | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: pg-test-client, labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: pg-test-client}}
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  nodeSelector: {pg-ha/role: infra}     # on the server node, so agent faults never take the observer down
  tolerations: [{key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane, operator: Exists, effect: NoSchedule}]
  securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 999, runAsGroup: 999, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
  containers:
  - name: client
    image: __PG_IMAGE__
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    command: [sleep, "7200"]
    securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
    env:
    - {name: HOME, value: /tmp}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L2 failure harness (R3.1-R3.7, R6.3, ADR-006). Usage: tests/failover.sh pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover
#   RUNS=n (default 3, switchover 1), TO=pg-N (switchover target, default the current sync standby)
#
# RTO = fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, seen by the probe Job
# (tests/probe-job.yaml), which writes through pg-rw every 500 ms. RPO = acknowledged sequence numbers
# missing on the new primary. Leadership is sampled twice every 500 ms: the lock holder from the pg-rw
# Endpoints object, and pg_is_in_recovery() asked of each member directly.
#
# Fault injection (D4, committed and documented):
#   pod          kubectl delete pod <primary> (default grace period, so Patroni shuts down normally)
#   node         docker stop <agent hosting the primary>, then docker start once a new leader holds the lock
#   storage      docker exec <agent> nsenter -m into the primary container and remount /data read-only, then
#                read-write again once a new leader holds the lock. See the evidence file for the limits.
#   split-brain  docker exec <agent> iptables: drop the primary pod's traffic to the API server backend only.
#                Pod-to-pod traffic, including replication, is untouched. The rule is removed afterwards.
#   switchover   POST /switchover to the leader's Patroni REST API through the API server pod proxy
#                (the REST API is unauthenticated until L6).
# psql runs only in the test client pod, never in a Postgres pod.
. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
MODE=${1:-}; case "$MODE" in pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover) ;; *) die "usage: $0 pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover" ;; esac
RUNS=${RUNS:-$([ "$MODE" = switchover ] && echo 1 || echo 3)}
[[ "$RUNS" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "RUNS must be 1-9"
case "$MODE" in pod) DURATION=70 ;; switchover) DURATION=50 ;; *) DURATION=110 ;; esac
W=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$EV_DIR/L2"; EV_FILE="$EV_DIR/L2/$MODE.md"
PENDING_RESTORE=""; SAMPLER_PIDS=""

restore_fault() {
  case "$PENDING_RESTORE" in
    node:*) docker start "${PENDING_RESTORE#node:}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    storage:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#storage:}; docker exec "$1" nsenter -t "$2" -m mount -o remount,rw,bind /data >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    split:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#split:}; docker exec "$1" iptables -D FORWARD -s "$2" -d "$3" -p tcp --dport "$4" -j DROP >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
  esac
  PENDING_RESTORE=""
}
stop_samplers() { [ -z "$SAMPLER_PIDS" ] || kill $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; wait $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; SAMPLER_PIDS=""; }
cleanup() {
  restore_fault; stop_samplers
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$CLIENT" --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$W" "$BODY" "$CHECKS"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

wait_until() { # timeout-seconds command...
  local end=$((SECONDS + $1)); shift
  until "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; do [ $SECONDS -lt $end ] || return 1; sleep 0.5; done
}
leader_is_not() { local l; l=$(leader); [ -n "$l" ] && [ "$l" != "$1" ]; }
leader_is() { [ "$(leader)" = "$1" ]; }
pod_uid() { kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}' 2>/dev/null; }
uid_changed() { local u; u=$(pod_uid "$1"); [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != "$2" ]; }
ts_of_log() { # "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,mmm" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm UTC" at line start -> epoch
  sed -E 's/^([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+)[.,]([0-9]+).*/\1.\2 UTC/' | head -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N
}
container_pid() { # agent pod -> host-visible PID of the Postgres container, via crictl on that node
  local id; id=$(docker exec "$1" crictl ps -q --name postgres --label "io.kubernetes.pod.name=$2" --label "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace=$NS")
  docker exec "$1" crictl inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$id"
}

client_up
kubectl get ns "$NS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "namespace $NS not found, run: make up"
SUMMARY=$(mktemp -p "$W")
printf '| Run | Old primary | New primary | RTO (s) | Write gap (s) | Acked | RPO (acked rows missing) | Max primaries in one sample | Rejoin | Rejoin after fault (s) | Result |\n|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---|\n' > "$SUMMARY"
RTOS=""

for N in $(seq 1 "$RUNS"); do

  FOUND=$( [ -n "$ACKED" ] && q "$RW" app "select count(*) from probe where run = '$RUN_ID' and seq in ($ACKED)" || echo 0)
  MISSING=$((NACK - ${FOUND:-0}))
  MAXP=$(awk '$1=="S" && $5=="f" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$R/samples.txt")
  NTICKS=$(awk '$1=="S" {print $2}' "$R/samples.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
  HOLDERS=$(awk '$1=="L" && NF>=3 {print $3}' "$R/lock.txt" | uniq | paste -sd'>' -)
  case "$MODE" in pod) LOGARGS="$OLD" ;; *) LOGARGS="$OLD --since-time=$(date -u -d "@${T_FAULT%.*}" +%FT%TZ)" ;; esac
  kubectl -n "$NS" logs $LOGARGS > "$R/old.log" 2>/dev/null || true
  if grep -qiE 'Removing data directory|replica has been created using basebackup|bootstrap from leader' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="re-clone"
  elif grep -qiE 'running pg_rewind|pg_rewind.*(success|done)|rewind' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="pg_rewind"
  else REJOIN="restart only"; fi
  TL1=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline')
  OLD_TL=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r --arg o "$OLD" '.members[] | select(.name == $o) | .timeline')

  note "Probe: $NACK acknowledged, $NERR failed attempts. Lock holders sampled: \`$HOLDERS\`. Leadership samples: $NTICKS rounds of 3 members."
  note "First acknowledged write on the new primary at $( [ -n "$FIRST_NEW" ] && iso "$FIRST_NEW" || echo none) UTC. Last on the old primary at $( [ -n "$LAST_OLD" ] && iso "$LAST_OLD" || echo none) UTC. Timeline $TL0 -> $TL1. Fault restored at $(iso "$T_RESTORE"), old member streaming from the new primary at $(iso "$T_REJOIN") UTC."
  run "grep -iE 'rewind|basebackup|Removing data|bootstrap from leader|Demoting|demote|promot|shut down|immediate shutdown|read-only|PANIC' $R/old.log | sed -E 's/[0-9a-f]{32,}/[hex]/g' | head -12" || true
  [ "$MODE" != switchover ] || run "cat $R/switchover.txt" || true
  check "run $N: writes resumed on the new primary (RTO $RTO s)" test -n "$FIRST_NEW"
  check "run $N: RPO 0, all $NACK acknowledged rows present on the new primary" test "$MISSING" = 0
  check "run $N: never more than 1 member out of recovery in any sample" test "$MAXP" -le 1
  check "run $N: no acknowledged write on the old primary after the new primary's first" test "$OVERLAP" = 0
  check "run $N: old primary $OLD rejoined as a streaming replica of $NEW, sync standby restored" test $rj = 0
  check "run $N: old primary in recovery on the new leader's timeline" bash -c "[ \"\$(q $(member "$OLD") monitor 'select pg_is_in_recovery()')\" = t ] && [ '$OLD_TL' = '$TL1' ]"

  if [ "$MODE" = split-brain ]; then
    # ADR-006: demotion must complete before the old lock can expire (last renewal + ttl 20 s).
    LAST_RENEW=$(awk -v o="$OLD" '$1=="L" && $3==o {print $4}' "$R/lock.txt" | sort | tail -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    ACQ=$(lock | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    T_DEMOTE=$(grep -iE 'demot' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    T_STOPPED=$(grep -E 'database system is shut down' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    note "Last lock renewal by $OLD: $( [ -n "$LAST_RENEW" ] && iso "$LAST_RENEW") UTC. Demotion issued +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE") s (bound 13 s). Postgres stopped +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED") s. Last acknowledged write on the old primary +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$LAST_OLD") s. New leader $NEW acquired the lock +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$ACQ") s (ttl 20 s)."
    check "run $N: demotion issued within 13 s of the last renewal" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 13.5)}'
    check "run $N: old primary stopped within 20 s of the last renewal (13 s + 7 s stop budget)" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 20)}'
    check "run $N: old primary's last acknowledged write precedes the new leader's lock acquisition" awk -v a="${LAST_OLD:-0}" -v b="${ACQ:-0}" 'BEGIN{exit !(b > 0 && a < b)}'
  fi
  res=PASS; [ $FAILS -eq $run_fails ] || res=FAIL
  printf '| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n' "$N" "$OLD" "$NEW" "$RTO" "$GAP" "$NACK" "$MISSING" "$MAXP" "$REJOIN" "$(secs "$T_FAULT" "$T_REJOIN")" "$res" >> "$SUMMARY"
  RTOS="$RTOS $RTO"
  log "run $N: RTO=$RTO s gap=$GAP s acked=$NACK missing=$MISSING maxprimaries=$MAXP rejoin=$REJOIN $res"
done

# Evidence file for this mode, then the combined L2 summary.
verdict=PASS; [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ] || verdict=FAIL
STATS=$(tr ' ' '\n' <<<"$RTOS" | grep -E '^[0-9.]+$' | sort -n | awk '{a[NR]=$1} END {if (NR) printf "min %.2f s, median %.2f s, max %.2f s over %d runs", a[1], (NR%2 ? a[(NR+1)/2] : (a[NR/2]+a[NR/2+1])/2), a[NR], NR; else print "no RTO measured"}')
case "$MODE" in
  pod) DESC='`kubectl delete pod` on the primary, with the default grace period. Patroni shuts Postgres down and releases the lock, so this measures a clean handover. An abrupt death is covered by the node mode.' ;;
  node) DESC='`docker stop` on the k3d agent container hosting the primary (D6), restarted with `docker start` once a new leader holds the lock. Every process on that node dies, so the lock must expire (ttl 20 s) before a replica can take over.' ;;
  storage) DESC='The primary'"'"'s data volume is remounted read-only inside the Postgres container'"'"'s mount namespace (`docker exec <agent> nsenter -t <pid> -m mount -o remount,ro,bind /data`), and remounted read-write once a new leader holds the lock. **Limits:** the disk is not removed. Reads of cached pages and already-open files can still succeed, only writes fail, and the failure is clean (EROFS) rather than a hang or silent corruption. A real detached or hung disk can block I/O instead, which this does not show.' ;;
  split-brain) DESC='An iptables rule on the primary'"'"'s node drops only the primary pod'"'"'s traffic to the API server backend (the S2 finding: policy and filtering see the real backend address). Replication and client traffic are untouched, so the old primary can still reach its sync standby and acknowledge commits until it demotes itself. The rule is removed afterwards.' ;;
  switchover) DESC='`POST /switchover` to the leader'"'"'s Patroni REST API through the API server pod proxy, naming the target (default the current sync standby). **The REST API is unauthenticated until L6.**' ;;
esac
{ printf '# L2 failure mode: %s\n\n**Result: %s**\n\n' "$MODE" "$verdict"
  printf -- '- **Fault:** %s\n' "$DESC"
  printf -- '- **Run:** %s (UTC), %s s\n- **Reproduce:** `make %s`\n' "$STARTED" "$((SECONDS-T0))" "$([ "$MODE" = switchover ] && echo switchover || ([ "$MODE" = split-brain ] && echo test-split-brain || echo "failover-$MODE"))"
  printf -- '- **Versions:** k3s `%s`, image `%s`\n' "${K3S_IMAGE%@*}" "$PG_IMAGE"
  printf -- '- **Method:** RTO is fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, from a probe writing through pg-rw every 500 ms. Write gap is the last acknowledged write before that to the first after it. RPO counts acknowledged rows missing on the new primary.\n'
  printf '\n## Summary\n\n%s\n\nRTO: %s. Target 30 s.\n\n## Checks\n\n| Check | Result |\n|---|---|\n' "$(cat "$SUMMARY")" "$STATS"
  cat "$CHECKS"; cat "$BODY"; } | redact > "$EV_FILE"

{ printf '# L2: failover, switchover and split-brain\n\nGenerated from the per-mode files in [`L2/`](L2/) each time a mode runs. Timestamps are UTC.\n\n'
  printf 'RTO is fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, measured by a probe Job writing through pg-rw every 500 ms over new connections with a 2 s connect timeout. RPO is the number of acknowledged rows missing on the new primary. The target is RTO at most 30 s with safe settings (ttl 20, loop_wait 3, retry_timeout 5).\n'
  for f in pod node storage split-brain switchover; do
    [ -f "$EV_DIR/L2/$f.md" ] || { printf '\n## %s\n\nNot run yet.\n' "$f"; continue; }
    printf '\n## %s: %s\n\n' "$f" "$(grep -m1 -oE 'Result: (PASS|FAIL)' "$EV_DIR/L2/$f.md")"
    sed -n '/^- \*\*Fault:\*\*/p' "$EV_DIR/L2/$f.md"
    printf -- '- Details: [`L2/%s.md`](L2/%s.md)\n\n' "$f" "$f"
    sed -n '/^## Summary/,/^## Checks/p' "$EV_DIR/L2/$f.md" | sed '1d;$d'
  done; } > "$EV_DIR/L2-failover.md"
log "RESULT L2 $MODE: $verdict ($STATS) -> docs/evidence/L2/$MODE.md"
[ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L2 failure harness (R3.1-R3.7, R6.3, ADR-006). Usage: tests/failover.sh pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover
#   RUNS=n (default 3, switchover 1), TO=pg-N (switchover target, default the current sync standby)
#
# RTO = fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, seen by the probe Job
# (tests/probe-job.yaml), which writes through pg-rw every 500 ms. RPO = acknowledged sequence numbers
# missing on the new primary. Leadership is sampled twice every 500 ms: the lock holder from the pg-rw
# Endpoints object, and pg_is_in_recovery() asked of each member directly.
#
# Fault injection (D4, committed and documented):
#   pod          kubectl delete pod <primary> (default grace period, so Patroni shuts down normally)
#   node         docker stop <agent hosting the primary>, then docker start once a new leader holds the lock
#   storage      docker exec <agent> nsenter -m into the primary container and remount /data read-only, then
#                read-write again once a new leader holds the lock. See the evidence file for the limits.
#   split-brain  docker exec <agent> iptables: drop the primary pod's traffic to the API server backend only.
#                Pod-to-pod traffic, including replication, is untouched. The rule is removed afterwards.
#   switchover   POST /switchover to the leader's Patroni REST API through the API server pod proxy
#                (the REST API is unauthenticated until L6).
# psql runs only in the test client pod, never in a Postgres pod.
. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
MODE=${1:-}; case "$MODE" in pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover) ;; *) die "usage: $0 pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover" ;; esac
RUNS=${RUNS:-$([ "$MODE" = switchover ] && echo 1 || echo 3)}
[[ "$RUNS" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "RUNS must be 1-9"
case "$MODE" in pod) DURATION=70 ;; switchover) DURATION=50 ;; *) DURATION=110 ;; esac
W=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$EV_DIR/L2"; EV_FILE="$EV_DIR/L2/$MODE.md"
PENDING_RESTORE=""; SAMPLER_PIDS=""

restore_fault() {
  case "$PENDING_RESTORE" in
    node:*) docker start "${PENDING_RESTORE#node:}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    storage:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#storage:}; docker exec "$1" nsenter -t "$2" -m mount -o remount,rw,bind /data >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    split:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#split:}; docker exec "$1" iptables -D FORWARD -s "$2" -d "$3" -p tcp --dport "$4" -j DROP >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
  esac
  PENDING_RESTORE=""
}
stop_samplers() { [ -z "$SAMPLER_PIDS" ] || kill $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; wait $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; SAMPLER_PIDS=""; }
cleanup() {
  restore_fault; stop_samplers
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$CLIENT" --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$W" "$BODY" "$CHECKS"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

wait_until() { # timeout-seconds command...
  local end=$((SECONDS + $1)); shift
  until "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; do [ $SECONDS -lt $end ] || return 1; sleep 0.5; done
}
leader_is_not() { local l; l=$(leader); [ -n "$l" ] && [ "$l" != "$1" ]; }
leader_is() { [ "$(leader)" = "$1" ]; }
pod_uid() { kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}' 2>/dev/null; }
uid_changed() { local u; u=$(pod_uid "$1"); [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != "$2" ]; }
ts_of_log() { # "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,mmm" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm UTC" at line start -> epoch
  sed -E 's/^([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+)[.,]([0-9]+).*/\1.\2 UTC/' | head -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N
}
container_pid() { # agent pod -> host-visible PID of the Postgres container, via crictl on that node
  local id; id=$(docker exec "$1" crictl ps -q --name postgres --label "io.kubernetes.pod.name=$2" --label "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace=$NS")
  docker exec "$1" crictl inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$id"
}

client_up
kubectl get ns "$NS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "namespace $NS not found, run: make up"
SUMMARY=$(mktemp -p "$W")
printf '| Run | Old primary | New primary | RTO (s) | Write gap (s) | Acked | RPO (acked rows missing) | Max primaries in one sample | Rejoin | Rejoin after fault (s) | Result |\n|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---|\n' > "$SUMMARY"
RTOS=""

for N in $(seq 1 "$RUNS"); do
  R="$W/run$N"; mkdir -p "$R"; run_fails=$FAILS
  section "Run $N"
  wait_until 240 primary_confirms || die "cluster not healthy before run $N, see: make status"
  sleep 3
  OLD=$(leader); OLD_IP=$(pod_ip "$OLD"); OLD_NODE=$(pod_node "$OLD"); OLD_UID=$(pod_uid "$OLD")
  SYNC=$(sync_standby); TL0=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline')
  TARGET=${TO:-$SYNC}
  [ "$MODE" != switchover ] || [ "$TARGET" != "$OLD" ] || die "switchover target $TARGET is already the leader"
  RUN_ID="$MODE-$N-$(date +%s)"

  # Probe, then samplers. Nothing is deployed or reconfigured during the measured window.
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
  sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|; s|__RUN_ID__|$RUN_ID|; s|__DURATION__|$DURATION|" "$ROOT_DIR/tests/probe-job.yaml" | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
  wait_until 90 bash -c "[ \$(kubectl -n $NS logs job/pg-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^ACK') -ge 6 ]" || die "probe did not start acknowledging writes"
  ( while :; do echo "L $(now) $(lock)"; sleep 0.5; done ) > "$R/lock.txt" 2>/dev/null & SAMPLER_PIDS="$!"
  kubectl -n "$NS" exec "$CLIENT" -- sh -c 'end=$(( $(date +%s) + 600 )); i=0
    while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do i=$((i+1))
      for m in pg-0 pg-1 pg-2; do ( r=$(PGPASSWORD=$MON_PW psql "host=$m.pg-headless.pg-ha.svc.cluster.local user=monitor dbname=app connect_timeout=2" -XAtqc "select pg_is_in_recovery()" 2>/dev/null) || r=x; echo "S $i $(date +%s.%N) $m ${r:-x}" ) & done
      sleep 0.5; done' > "$R/samples.txt" 2>/dev/null & SAMPLER_PIDS="$SAMPLER_PIDS $!"
  sleep 2

  # Fault.
  case "$MODE" in
    pod) T_FAULT=$(now); kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$OLD" --wait=false >/dev/null ;;
    node) T_FAULT=$(now); docker stop "$OLD_NODE" >/dev/null; PENDING_RESTORE="node:$OLD_NODE" ;;
    storage)
      PID=$(container_pid "$OLD_NODE" "$OLD")
      T_FAULT=$(now); docker exec "$OLD_NODE" nsenter -t "$PID" -m mount -o remount,ro,bind /data
      PENDING_RESTORE="storage:$OLD_NODE $PID" ;;
    split-brain)
      API=$(kubectl get endpointslice -n default -l kubernetes.io/service-name=kubernetes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].endpoints[0].addresses[0]} {.items[0].ports[0].port}')
      set -- $API; API_IP=$1; API_PORT=$2
      T_FAULT=$(now); docker exec "$OLD_NODE" iptables -I FORWARD 1 -s "$OLD_IP" -d "$API_IP" -p tcp --dport "$API_PORT" -j DROP
      PENDING_RESTORE="split:$OLD_NODE $OLD_IP $API_IP $API_PORT" ;;
    switchover)
      printf '{"leader": "%s", "candidate": "%s"}' "$OLD" "$TARGET" > "$R/body.json"
      T_FAULT=$(now); kubectl create --raw "/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/pods/$OLD:8008/proxy/switchover" -f "$R/body.json" > "$R/switchover.txt" 2>&1 || true ;;
  esac
  note "Fault at $(iso "$T_FAULT") UTC on primary \`$OLD\` ($OLD_IP, node \`$OLD_NODE\`, timeline $TL0). Sync standby before: \`$SYNC\`."
  if [ "$MODE" = switchover ]; then wait_until 90 leader_is "$TARGET"; got=$?; else wait_until 120 leader_is_not "$OLD"; got=$?; fi
  T_LOCK=$(now); NEW=$(leader)
  check "run $N: lock moved from $OLD to a new leader ($NEW)" test $got = 0
  restore_fault; T_RESTORE=$(now)

  # Rejoin: a new pod where one is expected, then confirmed from the primary, not from Patroni alone.
  [ "$MODE" != pod ] || wait_until 180 uid_changed "$OLD" "$OLD_UID" || true
  wait_until 300 primary_confirms "$OLD"; rj=$?; T_REJOIN=$(now)
  wait_until $((DURATION + 60)) bash -c "kubectl -n $NS logs job/pg-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^DONE'" || true
  stop_samplers
  kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-probe > "$R/probe.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  NEW_IP=$(pod_ip "$NEW")

  # Analysis.
  FIRST_NEW=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" -v t="$T_FAULT" '$1=="ACK" && $6!=ip && $4>t {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | head -1)
  LAST_OLD=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" '$1=="ACK" && $6==ip {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
  PREV=$(awk -v f="${FIRST_NEW:-0}" '$1=="ACK" && $4<f {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
  RTO=$(secs "$T_FAULT" "$FIRST_NEW"); GAP=$(secs "$PREV" "$FIRST_NEW")
  OVERLAP=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" -v f="${FIRST_NEW:-9e99}" '$1=="ACK" && $6==ip && $4>f' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l)
  ACKED=$(awk '$1=="ACK" {print $2}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | paste -sd, -)
  NACK=$(awk '$1=="ACK"' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l); NERR=$(awk '$1=="ERR"' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l)
  FOUND=$( [ -n "$ACKED" ] && q "$RW" app "select count(*) from probe where run = '$RUN_ID' and seq in ($ACKED)" || echo 0)
  MISSING=$((NACK - ${FOUND:-0}))
  MAXP=$(awk '$1=="S" && $5=="f" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$R/samples.txt")
  NTICKS=$(awk '$1=="S" {print $2}' "$R/samples.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
  HOLDERS=$(awk '$1=="L" && NF>=3 {print $3}' "$R/lock.txt" | uniq | paste -sd'>' -)
  case "$MODE" in pod) LOGARGS="$OLD" ;; *) LOGARGS="$OLD --since-time=$(date -u -d "@${T_FAULT%.*}" +%FT%TZ)" ;; esac
  kubectl -n "$NS" logs $LOGARGS > "$R/old.log" 2>/dev/null || true
  if grep -qiE 'Removing data directory|replica has been created using basebackup|bootstrap from leader' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="re-clone"
  elif grep -qiE 'running pg_rewind|pg_rewind.*(success|done)|rewind' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="pg_rewind"
  else REJOIN="restart only"; fi
  TL1=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline')
  OLD_TL=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r --arg o "$OLD" '.members[] | select(.name == $o) | .timeline')

  note "Probe: $NACK acknowledged, $NERR failed attempts. Lock holders sampled: \`$HOLDERS\`. Leadership samples: $NTICKS rounds of 3 members."
  note "First acknowledged write on the new primary at $( [ -n "$FIRST_NEW" ] && iso "$FIRST_NEW" || echo none) UTC. Last on the old primary at $( [ -n "$LAST_OLD" ] && iso "$LAST_OLD" || echo none) UTC. Timeline $TL0 -> $TL1. Fault restored at $(iso "$T_RESTORE"), old member streaming from the new primary at $(iso "$T_REJOIN") UTC."
  run "grep -iE 'rewind|basebackup|Removing data|bootstrap from leader|Demoting|demote|promot|shut down|immediate shutdown|read-only|PANIC' $R/old.log | sed -E 's/[0-9a-f]{32,}/[hex]/g' | head -12" || true
  [ "$MODE" != switchover ] || run "cat $R/switchover.txt" || true
  check "run $N: writes resumed on the new primary (RTO $RTO s)" test -n "$FIRST_NEW"
  check "run $N: RPO 0, all $NACK acknowledged rows present on the new primary" test "$MISSING" = 0
  check "run $N: never more than 1 member out of recovery in any sample" test "$MAXP" -le 1
  check "run $N: no acknowledged write on the old primary after the new primary's first" test "$OVERLAP" = 0
  check "run $N: old primary $OLD rejoined as a streaming replica of $NEW, sync standby restored" test $rj = 0
  check "run $N: old primary in recovery on the new leader's timeline" bash -c "[ \"\$(q $(member "$OLD") monitor 'select pg_is_in_recovery()')\" = t ] && [ '$OLD_TL' = '$TL1' ]"

    LAST_RENEW=$(awk -v o="$OLD" '$1=="L" && $3==o {print $4}' "$R/lock.txt" | sort | tail -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    ACQ=$(lock | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    T_DEMOTE=$(grep -iE 'demot' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    T_STOPPED=$(grep -E 'database system is shut down' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    note "Last lock renewal by $OLD: $( [ -n "$LAST_RENEW" ] && iso "$LAST_RENEW") UTC. Demotion issued +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE") s (bound 13 s). Postgres stopped +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED") s. Last acknowledged write on the old primary +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$LAST_OLD") s. New leader $NEW acquired the lock +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$ACQ") s (ttl 20 s)."
    check "run $N: demotion issued within 13 s of the last renewal" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 13.5)}'
    check "run $N: old primary stopped within 20 s of the last renewal (13 s + 7 s stop budget)" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 20)}'

  log "run $N: RTO=$RTO s gap=$GAP s acked=$NACK missing=$MISSING maxprimaries=$MAXP rejoin=$REJOIN $res"
done

verdict=PASS; [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ] || verdict=FAIL
STATS=$(tr ' ' '\n' <<<"$RTOS" | grep -E '^[0-9.]+$' | sort -n | awk '{a[NR]=$1} END {if (NR) printf "min %.2f s, median %.2f s, max %.2f s over %d runs", a[1], (NR%2 ? a[(NR+1)/2] : (a[NR/2]+a[NR/2+1])/2), a[NR], NR; else print "no RTO measured"}')
case "$MODE" in
  pod) DESC='`kubectl delete pod` on the primary, with the default grace period. Patroni shuts Postgres down and releases the lock, so this measures a clean handover. An abrupt death is covered by the node mode.' ;;
  node) DESC='`docker stop` on the k3d agent container hosting the primary (D6), restarted with `docker start` once a new leader holds the lock. Every process on that node dies, so the lock must expire (ttl 20 s) before a replica can take over.' ;;

Reads of cached pages and already-open files can still succeed, only writes fail, and the failure is clean (EROFS) rather than a hang or silent corruption. A real detached or hung disk can block I/O instead, which this does not show.' ;;
  split-brain) DESC='An iptables rule on the primary'"'"'s node drops only the primary pod'"'"'s traffic to the API server backend (the S2 finding: policy and filtering see the real backend address). Replication and client traffic are untouched, so the old primary can still reach its sync standby and acknowledge commits until it demotes itself. The rule is removed afterwards.' ;;

{ printf '# L2 failure mode: %s\n\n**Result: %s**\n\n' "$MODE" "$verdict"
  printf -- '- **Fault:** %s\n' "$DESC"
  printf -- '- **Run:** %s (UTC), %s s\n- **Reproduce:** `make %s`\n' "$STARTED" "$((SECONDS-T0))" "$([ "$MODE" = switchover ] && echo switchover || ([ "$MODE" = split-brain ] && echo test-split-brain || echo "failover-$MODE"))"
  printf -- '- **Versions:** k3s `%s`, image `%s`\n' "${K3S_IMAGE%@*}" "$PG_IMAGE"
  printf -- '- **Method:** RTO is fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, from a probe writing through pg-rw every 500 ms. Write gap is the last acknowledged write before that to the first after it. RPO counts acknowledged rows missing on the new primary.\n'

{ printf '# L2: failover, switchover and split-brain\n\nGenerated from the per-mode files in [`L2/`](L2/) each time a mode runs. Timestamps are UTC.\n\n'

    printf -- '- Details: [`L2/%s.md`](L2/%s.md)\n\n' "$f" "$f"
    sed -n '/^## Summary/,/^## Checks/p' "$EV_DIR/L2/$f.md" | sed '1d;$d'
  done; } > "$EV_DIR/L2-failover.md"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L2 failure harness (R3.1-R3.7, R6.3, ADR-006). Usage: tests/failover.sh pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover
#   RUNS=n (default 3, switchover 1), TO=pg-N (switchover target, default the current sync standby)
#
# RTO = fault injection to the first commit acknowledged by a new primary, seen by the probe Job
# (tests/probe-job.yaml), which writes through pg-rw every 500 ms. RPO = acknowledged sequence numbers
# missing on the new primary. Leadership is sampled twice every 500 ms: the lock holder from the pg-rw
# Endpoints object, and pg_is_in_recovery() asked of each member directly.
#
# Fault injection (D4, committed and documented):
#   pod          kubectl delete pod <primary> (default grace period, so Patroni shuts down normally)
#   node         docker stop <agent hosting the primary>, then docker start once a new leader holds the lock
#   storage      docker exec <agent> nsenter -m into the primary container and remount /data read-only, then
#                read-write again once a new leader holds the lock. See the evidence file for the limits.
#   split-brain  docker exec <agent> iptables: drop the primary pod's traffic to the API server backend only.
#                Pod-to-pod traffic, including replication, is untouched. The rule is removed afterwards.
#   switchover   POST /switchover to the leader's Patroni REST API through the API server pod proxy
#                (the REST API is unauthenticated until L6).
# psql runs only in the test client pod, never in a Postgres pod.
. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
MODE=${1:-}; case "$MODE" in pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover) ;; *) die "usage: $0 pod|node|storage|split-brain|switchover" ;; esac
RUNS=${RUNS:-$([ "$MODE" = switchover ] && echo 1 || echo 3)}
[[ "$RUNS" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "RUNS must be 1-9"
case "$MODE" in pod) DURATION=70 ;; switchover) DURATION=50 ;; *) DURATION=110 ;; esac
W=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$EV_DIR/L2"; EV_FILE="$EV_DIR/L2/$MODE.md"
PENDING_RESTORE=""; SAMPLER_PIDS=""

restore_fault() {
  case "$PENDING_RESTORE" in
    node:*) docker start "${PENDING_RESTORE#node:}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    storage:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#storage:}; docker exec "$1" nsenter -t "$2" -m mount -o remount,rw,bind /data >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
    split:*) set -- ${PENDING_RESTORE#split:}; docker exec "$1" iptables -D FORWARD -s "$2" -d "$3" -p tcp --dport "$4" -j DROP >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;;
  esac
  PENDING_RESTORE=""
}
stop_samplers() { [ -z "$SAMPLER_PIDS" ] || kill $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; wait $SAMPLER_PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; SAMPLER_PIDS=""; }
cleanup() {
  restore_fault; stop_samplers
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$CLIENT" --ignore-not-found --wait=false >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$W" "$BODY" "$CHECKS"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

wait_until() { # timeout-seconds command...
  local end=$((SECONDS + $1)); shift
  until "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; do [ $SECONDS -lt $end ] || return 1; sleep 0.5; done
}
leader_is_not() { local l; l=$(leader); [ -n "$l" ] && [ "$l" != "$1" ]; }
leader_is() { [ "$(leader)" = "$1" ]; }
pod_uid() { kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}' 2>/dev/null; }
uid_changed() { local u; u=$(pod_uid "$1"); [ -n "$u" ] && [ "$u" != "$2" ]; }
ts_of_log() { # "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,mmm" or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm UTC" at line start -> epoch
  sed -E 's/^([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+)[.,]([0-9]+).*/\1.\2 UTC/' | head -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N
}
container_pid() { # agent pod -> host-visible PID of the Postgres container, via crictl on that node
  local id; id=$(docker exec "$1" crictl ps -q --name postgres --label "io.kubernetes.pod.name=$2" --label "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace=$NS")
  docker exec "$1" crictl inspect -o go-template --template '{{.info.pid}}' "$id"
}

client_up
kubectl get ns "$NS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "namespace $NS not found, run: make up"
SUMMARY=$(mktemp -p "$W")
printf '| Run | Old primary | New primary | RTO (s) | Write gap (s) | Acked | RPO (acked rows missing) | Max primaries in one sample | Rejoin | Rejoin after fault (s) | Result |\n|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---|\n' > "$SUMMARY"
RTOS=""

for N in $(seq 1 "$RUNS"); do
  R="$W/run$N"; mkdir -p "$R"; run_fails=$FAILS
  section "Run $N"
  wait_until 240 primary_confirms || die "cluster not healthy before run $N, see: make status"
  sleep 3
  OLD=$(leader); OLD_IP=$(pod_ip "$OLD"); OLD_NODE=$(pod_node "$OLD"); OLD_UID=$(pod_uid "$OLD")
  SYNC=$(sync_standby); TL0=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline')
  TARGET=${TO:-$SYNC}
  [ "$MODE" != switchover ] || [ "$TARGET" != "$OLD" ] || die "switchover target $TARGET is already the leader"
  RUN_ID="$MODE-$N-$(date +%s)"

  # Probe, then samplers. Nothing is deployed or reconfigured during the measured window.
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
  sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|; s|__RUN_ID__|$RUN_ID|; s|__DURATION__|$DURATION|" "$ROOT_DIR/tests/probe-job.yaml" | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
  wait_until 90 bash -c "[ \$(kubectl -n $NS logs job/pg-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^ACK') -ge 6 ]" || die "probe did not start acknowledging writes"
  ( while :; do echo "L $(now) $(lock)"; sleep 0.5; done ) > "$R/lock.txt" 2>/dev/null & SAMPLER_PIDS="$!"
  kubectl -n "$NS" exec "$CLIENT" -- sh -c 'end=$(( $(date +%s) + 600 )); i=0
    while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do i=$((i+1))
      for m in pg-0 pg-1 pg-2; do ( r=$(PGPASSWORD=$MON_PW psql "host=$m.pg-headless.pg-ha.svc.cluster.local user=monitor dbname=app connect_timeout=2" -XAtqc "select pg_is_in_recovery()" 2>/dev/null) || r=x; echo "S $i $(date +%s.%N) $m ${r:-x}" ) & done
      sleep 0.5; done' > "$R/samples.txt" 2>/dev/null & SAMPLER_PIDS="$SAMPLER_PIDS $!"
  sleep 2

  # Fault.
  case "$MODE" in
    pod) T_FAULT=$(now); kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$OLD" --wait=false >/dev/null ;;
    node) T_FAULT=$(now); docker stop "$OLD_NODE" >/dev/null; PENDING_RESTORE="node:$OLD_NODE" ;;
    storage)
      PID=$(container_pid "$OLD_NODE" "$OLD")
      T_FAULT=$(now); docker exec "$OLD_NODE" nsenter -t "$PID" -m mount -o remount,ro,bind /data
      PENDING_RESTORE="storage:$OLD_NODE $PID" ;;
    split-brain)
      API=$(kubectl get endpointslice -n default -l kubernetes.io/service-name=kubernetes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].endpoints[0].addresses[0]} {.items[0].ports[0].port}')
      set -- $API; API_IP=$1; API_PORT=$2
      T_FAULT=$(now); docker exec "$OLD_NODE" iptables -I FORWARD 1 -s "$OLD_IP" -d "$API_IP" -p tcp --dport "$API_PORT" -j DROP
      PENDING_RESTORE="split:$OLD_NODE $OLD_IP $API_IP $API_PORT" ;;
    switchover)
      printf '{"leader": "%s", "candidate": "%s"}' "$OLD" "$TARGET" > "$R/body.json"
      T_FAULT=$(now); kubectl create --raw "/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/pods/$OLD:8008/proxy/switchover" -f "$R/body.json" > "$R/switchover.txt" 2>&1 || true ;;
  esac
  note "Fault at $(iso "$T_FAULT") UTC on primary \`$OLD\` ($OLD_IP, node \`$OLD_NODE\`, timeline $TL0). Sync standby before: \`$SYNC\`."
  if [ "$MODE" = switchover ]; then wait_until 90 leader_is "$TARGET"; got=$?; else wait_until 120 leader_is_not "$OLD"; got=$?; fi
  T_LOCK=$(now); NEW=$(leader)
  check "run $N: lock moved from $OLD to a new leader ($NEW)" test $got = 0
  restore_fault; T_RESTORE=$(now)

  # Rejoin: a new pod where one is expected, then confirmed from the primary, not from Patroni alone.
  [ "$MODE" != pod ] || wait_until 180 uid_changed "$OLD" "$OLD_UID" || true
  wait_until 300 primary_confirms "$OLD"; rj=$?; T_REJOIN=$(now)
  wait_until $((DURATION + 60)) bash -c "kubectl -n $NS logs job/pg-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^DONE'" || true
  stop_samplers
  kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-probe > "$R/probe.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  NEW_IP=$(pod_ip "$NEW")

  # Analysis.
  FIRST_NEW=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" -v t="$T_FAULT" '$1=="ACK" && $6!=ip && $4>t {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | head -1)
  LAST_OLD=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" '$1=="ACK" && $6==ip {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
  PREV=$(awk -v f="${FIRST_NEW:-0}" '$1=="ACK" && $4<f {print $4}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
  RTO=$(secs "$T_FAULT" "$FIRST_NEW"); GAP=$(secs "$PREV" "$FIRST_NEW")
  OVERLAP=$(awk -v ip="$OLD_IP" -v f="${FIRST_NEW:-9e99}" '$1=="ACK" && $6==ip && $4>f' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l)
  ACKED=$(awk '$1=="ACK" {print $2}' "$R/probe.txt" | sort -n | paste -sd, -)
  NACK=$(awk '$1=="ACK"' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l); NERR=$(awk '$1=="ERR"' "$R/probe.txt" | wc -l)
  FOUND=$( [ -n "$ACKED" ] && q "$RW" app "select count(*) from probe where run = '$RUN_ID' and seq in ($ACKED)" || echo 0)
  MISSING=$((NACK - ${FOUND:-0}))
  MAXP=$(awk '$1=="S" && $5=="f" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$R/samples.txt")
  NTICKS=$(awk '$1=="S" {print $2}' "$R/samples.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
  HOLDERS=$(awk '$1=="L" && NF>=3 {print $3}' "$R/lock.txt" | uniq | paste -sd'>' -)
  case "$MODE" in pod) LOGARGS="$OLD" ;; *) LOGARGS="$OLD --since-time=$(date -u -d "@${T_FAULT%.*}" +%FT%TZ)" ;; esac
  kubectl -n "$NS" logs $LOGARGS > "$R/old.log" 2>/dev/null || true
  if grep -qiE 'Removing data directory|replica has been created using basebackup|bootstrap from leader' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="re-clone"
  elif grep -qiE 'running pg_rewind|pg_rewind.*(success|done)|rewind' "$R/old.log"; then REJOIN="pg_rewind"
  else REJOIN="restart only"; fi
  TL1=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r '.members[] | select(.role == "leader") | .timeline')
  OLD_TL=$(patroni_cluster | jq -r --arg o "$OLD" '.members[] | select(.name == $o) | .timeline')

  note "Probe: $NACK acknowledged, $NERR failed attempts. Lock holders sampled: \`$HOLDERS\`. Leadership samples: $NTICKS rounds of 3 members."
  note "First acknowledged write on the new primary at $( [ -n "$FIRST_NEW" ] && iso "$FIRST_NEW" || echo none) UTC. Last on the old primary at $( [ -n "$LAST_OLD" ] && iso "$LAST_OLD" || echo none) UTC. Timeline $TL0 -> $TL1. Fault restored at $(iso "$T_RESTORE"), old member streaming from the new primary at $(iso "$T_REJOIN") UTC."
  run "grep -iE 'rewind|basebackup|Removing data|bootstrap from leader|Demoting|demote|promot|shut down|immediate shutdown|read-only|PANIC' $R/old.log | sed -E 's/[0-9a-f]{32,}/[hex]/g' | head -12" || true
  [ "$MODE" != switchover ] || run "cat $R/switchover.txt" || true
  check "run $N: writes resumed on the new primary (RTO $RTO s)" test -n "$FIRST_NEW"
  check "run $N: RPO 0, all $NACK acknowledged rows present on the new primary" test "$MISSING" = 0
  check "run $N: never more than 1 member out of recovery in any sample" test "$MAXP" -le 1
  check "run $N: no acknowledged write on the old primary after the new primary's first" test "$OVERLAP" = 0
  check "run $N: old primary $OLD rejoined as a streaming replica of $NEW, sync standby restored" test $rj = 0
  check "run $N: old primary in recovery on the new leader's timeline" bash -c "[ \"\$(q $(member "$OLD") monitor 'select pg_is_in_recovery()')\" = t ] && [ '$OLD_TL' = '$TL1' ]"

  if [ "$MODE" = split-brain ]; then
    # ADR-006: demotion must complete before the old lock can expire (last renewal + ttl 20 s).
    LAST_RENEW=$(awk -v o="$OLD" '$1=="L" && $3==o {print $4}' "$R/lock.txt" | sort | tail -1 | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    ACQ=$(lock | awk '{print $3}' | xargs -r -I{} date -d {} +%s.%N)
    T_DEMOTE=$(grep -iE 'demot' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    T_STOPPED=$(grep -E 'database system is shut down' "$R/old.log" | head -1 | ts_of_log)
    note "Last lock renewal by $OLD: $( [ -n "$LAST_RENEW" ] && iso "$LAST_RENEW") UTC. Demotion issued +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE") s (bound 13 s). Postgres stopped +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED") s. Last acknowledged write on the old primary +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$LAST_OLD") s. New leader $NEW acquired the lock +$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$ACQ") s (ttl 20 s)."
    check "run $N: demotion issued within 13 s of the last renewal" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_DEMOTE")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 13.5)}'
    check "run $N: old primary stopped within 20 s of the last renewal (13 s + 7 s stop budget)" awk -v d="$(secs "$LAST_RENEW" "$T_STOPPED")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 20)}'
    check "run $N: old primary's last acknowledged write precedes the new leader's lock acquisition" awk -v a="${LAST_OLD:-0}" -v b="${ACQ:-0}" 'BEGIN{exit !(b > 0 && a < b)}'
  fi
  res=PASS; [ $FAILS -eq $run_fails ] || res=FAIL
  printf '| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n' "$N" "$OLD" "$NEW" "$RTO" "$GAP" "$NACK" "$MISSING" "$MAXP" "$REJOIN" "$(secs "$T_FAULT" "$T_REJOIN")" "$res" >> "$SUMMARY"
  RTOS="$RTOS $RTO"
  log "run $N: RTO=$RTO s gap=$GAP s acked=$NACK missing=$MISSING maxprimaries=$MAXP rejoin=$REJOIN $res"
done

input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# L2 optional: Kubernetes API outage (ADR-002, failsafe_mode off). Stops the k3d server container for
# OUTAGE seconds (default 60), then starts it again. Expected: every member demotes, so writes stop;
# reads continue; no two members are primary at once; a leader is elected once the API returns.
#
# Observation does not use make status or the API during the outage. A Job on an agent node, started
# beforehand, asks each member by pod IP (cluster DNS runs on the server, so it is down too) every second
# whether it is in recovery, and tries one write on each. Its log is read after the API returns.
# Fault injection (D4): docker stop / docker start of the k3d server container. No exec is used.
. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"
OUTAGE=${OUTAGE:-60}; [[ "$OUTAGE" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "OUTAGE must be seconds"
SERVER="k3d-$CLUSTER_NAME-server-0"; EV_FILE="$EV_DIR/L2/api-outage.md"; mkdir -p "$EV_DIR/L2"
W=$(mktemp -d); STOPPED=0
cleanup() { [ $STOPPED = 0 ] || docker start "$SERVER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$W" "$BODY" "$CHECKS"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
api_up() { kubectl get --raw /readyz >/dev/null 2>&1; }

client_up
until primary_confirms; do sleep 1; done
L=$(leader); IPS=""; for m in pg-0 pg-1 pg-2; do IPS="$IPS $m=$(pod_ip "$m")"; done
RUN_ID="api-outage-$(date +%s)"; DURATION=$((OUTAGE + 150))
kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-api-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|; s|__IPS__|${IPS# }|; s|__RUN__|$RUN_ID|; s|__DURATION__|$DURATION|" <<'YAML' | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: pg-api-probe}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      nodeSelector: {pg-ha/role: db}
      securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 999, runAsGroup: 999, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
      containers:
      - name: probe
        image: __PG_IMAGE__
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
        env:
        - {name: HOME, value: /tmp}
        - name: PGPASSWORD
          valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: pg-credentials, key: pg-app-password}}
        command: [bash, -c]
        args:
        - |
          end=$(( $(date +%s) + __DURATION__ )); i=0
          while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do i=$((i+1))
            for kv in __IPS__; do ( m=${kv%%=*}; ip=${kv#*=}; c="host=$ip user=app dbname=app connect_timeout=2"
              r=$(timeout 3 psql "$c" -XAtqc "select pg_is_in_recovery()" 2>/dev/null) || r=x
              w=no; timeout 3 psql "$c" -XAtq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "insert into probe (run, seq, client_ts) values ('__RUN__', $i * 10 + ${m#pg-}, now())" >/dev/null 2>&1 && w=yes
              echo "R $i $(date +%s.%N) $m ${r:-x} $w" ) & done
            sleep 1
          done; wait; echo DONE
        volumeMounts: [{name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}]
      volumes: [{name: tmp, emptyDir: {}}]
YAML
until [ "$(kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^R')" -ge 15 ]; do sleep 1; done

section "API server outage"
T_STOP=$(now); docker stop "$SERVER" >/dev/null; STOPPED=1
note "Leader before: \`$L\`. Server container \`$SERVER\` stopped at $(iso "$T_STOP") UTC for ${OUTAGE} s. Members by IP: \`${IPS# }\`."
sleep "$OUTAGE"
T_START=$(now); docker start "$SERVER" >/dev/null; STOPPED=0
until api_up; do sleep 1; done; T_API=$(now)
until primary_confirms 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; T_HEALTHY=$(now); L2=$(leader)
until kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^DONE'; do sleep 2; done
kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe > "$W/probe.txt"
kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-api-probe --wait=false >/dev/null

# Rounds are grouped by round number; times are each round's first sample.
awk '$1=="R"' "$W/probe.txt" | sort -k2,2n -k4,4 > "$W/r.txt"
LAST_PRIMARY_DURING=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $5=="f" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
LAST_WRITE_DURING=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $6=="yes" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
FIRST_WRITE_AFTER=$(awk -v b="$T_START" '$3>b && $6=="yes" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | head -1)
OUT_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b {print $2}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
READ_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $5=="t" {print $2}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
NOPRIM_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b {r[$2]=1} $3>a && $3<b && $5=="f" {p[$2]=1} END {n=0; for (k in r) if (!(k in p)) n++; print n}' "$W/r.txt")
MAXP=$(awk '$5=="f" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$W/r.txt")
WRITERS=$(awk '$6=="yes" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$W/r.txt")
note "During the outage: last sample with a primary +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_PRIMARY_DURING") s, last successful write +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_WRITE_DURING") s. $READ_ROUNDS of $OUT_ROUNDS rounds had a replica answering reads, and $NOPRIM_ROUNDS rounds had no primary at all. API back at +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_API") s, healthy with leader \`$L2\` at +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_HEALTHY") s, first write after restart +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$FIRST_WRITE_AFTER") s."
run "awk -v a=$T_STOP '\$3>a-3' $W/r.txt | awk '{printf \"%s round=%s %s in_recovery=%s write=%s\\n\", strftime(\"%H:%M:%S\", \$3, 1), \$2, \$4, \$5, \$6}' | awk 'NR%3==1 || /write=yes/' | head -40"
check "Every member demoted during the outage (writes stopped)" test -n "$LAST_WRITE_DURING" -a "$NOPRIM_ROUNDS" -gt 0
check "Demotion within 20 s of the outage starting (ttl)" awk -v d="$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_WRITE_DURING")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 20)}'
check "Reads continued on replicas in every outage round" test "$READ_ROUNDS" = "$OUT_ROUNDS"
check "Never more than 1 primary in any round" test "$MAXP" -le 1
check "Never more than 1 member accepted a write in any round" test "$WRITERS" -le 1
check "A leader was elected and replication healthy after the API returned" test -n "$T_HEALTHY"

verdict=PASS; [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ] || verdict=FAIL
{ printf '# L2 failure mode: api-outage\n\n**Result: %s**\n\n' "$verdict"
  printf -- '- **Fault:** `docker stop` on the k3d server container for %s s, then `docker start`. With `failsafe_mode` off (ADR-002), every member should demote, so writes stop and reads continue. Observed by a Job on an agent node that queried each member by pod IP every second. Its log was read after the API returned, so nothing depends on `make status` or the API during the outage.\n' "$OUTAGE"

cleanup() { [ $STOPPED = 0 ] || docker start "$SERVER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$W" "$BODY" "$CHECKS"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
api_up() { kubectl get --raw /readyz >/dev/null 2>&1; }

client_up
until primary_confirms; do sleep 1; done
L=$(leader); IPS=""; for m in pg-0 pg-1 pg-2; do IPS="$IPS $m=$(pod_ip "$m")"; done
RUN_ID="api-outage-$(date +%s)"; DURATION=$((OUTAGE + 150))
kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-api-probe --ignore-not-found --wait=true >/dev/null
sed "s|__PG_IMAGE__|$PG_IMAGE|; s|__IPS__|${IPS# }|; s|__RUN__|$RUN_ID|; s|__DURATION__|$DURATION|" <<'YAML' | kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - >/dev/null
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: {name: pg-api-probe}
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      nodeSelector: {pg-ha/role: db}
      securityContext: {runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 999, runAsGroup: 999, seccompProfile: {type: RuntimeDefault}}
      containers:
      - name: probe
        image: __PG_IMAGE__
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        securityContext: {allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, capabilities: {drop: [ALL]}}
        env:
        - {name: HOME, value: /tmp}
        - name: PGPASSWORD
          valueFrom: {secretKeyRef: {name: pg-credentials, key: pg-app-password}}
        command: [bash, -c]
        args:
        - |
          end=$(( $(date +%s) + __DURATION__ )); i=0
          while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do i=$((i+1))
            for kv in __IPS__; do ( m=${kv%%=*}; ip=${kv#*=}; c="host=$ip user=app dbname=app connect_timeout=2"
              r=$(timeout 3 psql "$c" -XAtqc "select pg_is_in_recovery()" 2>/dev/null) || r=x
              w=no; timeout 3 psql "$c" -XAtq -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "insert into probe (run, seq, client_ts) values ('__RUN__', $i * 10 + ${m#pg-}, now())" >/dev/null 2>&1 && w=yes
              echo "R $i $(date +%s.%N) $m ${r:-x} $w" ) & done
            sleep 1
          done; wait; echo DONE
        volumeMounts: [{name: tmp, mountPath: /tmp}]
      volumes: [{name: tmp, emptyDir: {}}]

until [ "$(kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^R')" -ge 15 ]; do sleep 1; done

section "API server outage"
T_STOP=$(now); docker stop "$SERVER" >/dev/null; STOPPED=1
note "Leader before: \`$L\`. Server container \`$SERVER\` stopped at $(iso "$T_STOP") UTC for ${OUTAGE} s. Members by IP: \`${IPS# }\`."
sleep "$OUTAGE"
T_START=$(now); docker start "$SERVER" >/dev/null; STOPPED=0
until api_up; do sleep 1; done; T_API=$(now)
until primary_confirms 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; T_HEALTHY=$(now); L2=$(leader)
until kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^DONE'; do sleep 2; done
kubectl -n "$NS" logs job/pg-api-probe > "$W/probe.txt"
kubectl -n "$NS" delete job pg-api-probe --wait=false >/dev/null

# Rounds are grouped by round number; times are each round's first sample.
awk '$1=="R"' "$W/probe.txt" | sort -k2,2n -k4,4 > "$W/r.txt"
LAST_PRIMARY_DURING=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $5=="f" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
LAST_WRITE_DURING=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $6=="yes" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | tail -1)
FIRST_WRITE_AFTER=$(awk -v b="$T_START" '$3>b && $6=="yes" {print $3}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -n | head -1)
OUT_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b {print $2}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
READ_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b && $5=="t" {print $2}' "$W/r.txt" | sort -u | wc -l)
NOPRIM_ROUNDS=$(awk -v a="$T_STOP" -v b="$T_START" '$3>a && $3<b {r[$2]=1} $3>a && $3<b && $5=="f" {p[$2]=1} END {n=0; for (k in r) if (!(k in p)) n++; print n}' "$W/r.txt")
MAXP=$(awk '$5=="f" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$W/r.txt")
WRITERS=$(awk '$6=="yes" {c[$2]++} END {m=0; for (k in c) if (c[k]>m) m=c[k]; print m}' "$W/r.txt")
note "During the outage: last sample with a primary +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_PRIMARY_DURING") s, last successful write +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_WRITE_DURING") s. $READ_ROUNDS of $OUT_ROUNDS rounds had a replica answering reads, and $NOPRIM_ROUNDS rounds had no primary at all. API back at +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_API") s, healthy with leader \`$L2\` at +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_HEALTHY") s, first write after restart +$(secs "$T_STOP" "$FIRST_WRITE_AFTER") s."
run "awk -v a=$T_STOP '\$3>a-3' $W/r.txt | awk '{printf \"%s round=%s %s in_recovery=%s write=%s\\n\", strftime(\"%H:%M:%S\", \$3, 1), \$2, \$4, \$5, \$6}' | awk 'NR%3==1 || /write=yes/' | head -40"
check "Every member demoted during the outage (writes stopped)" test -n "$LAST_WRITE_DURING" -a "$NOPRIM_ROUNDS" -gt 0
check "Demotion within 20 s of the outage starting (ttl)" awk -v d="$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_WRITE_DURING")" 'BEGIN{exit !(d != "n/a" && d <= 20)}'
check "Reads continued on replicas in every outage round" test "$READ_ROUNDS" = "$OUT_ROUNDS"
check "Never more than 1 primary in any round" test "$MAXP" -le 1
check "Never more than 1 member accepted a write in any round" test "$WRITERS" -le 1
check "A leader was elected and replication healthy after the API returned" test -n "$T_HEALTHY"

verdict=PASS; [ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ] || verdict=FAIL
{ printf '# L2 failure mode: api-outage\n\n**Result: %s**\n\n' "$verdict"
  printf -- '- **Fault:** `docker stop` on the k3d server container for %s s, then `docker start`. With `failsafe_mode` off (ADR-002), every member should demote, so writes stop and reads continue. Observed by a Job on an agent node that queried each member by pod IP every second. Its log was read after the API returned, so nothing depends on `make status` or the API during the outage.\n' "$OUTAGE"
  printf -- '- **Run:** %s (UTC), %s s\n- **Reproduce:** `make test-api-outage`\n- **Versions:** k3s `%s`, image `%s`\n' "$STARTED" "$((SECONDS-T0))" "${K3S_IMAGE%%@*}" "$PG_IMAGE"
  printf '\n## Summary\n\n| Outage (s) | Last write during outage (s) | Rounds with no primary | Reads served | Max primaries in a round | API back (s) | Healthy again (s) | First write after (s) | Result |\n|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|\n'
  printf '| %s | +%s | %s of %s | %s of %s rounds | %s | +%s | +%s | +%s | %s |\n\n' "$OUTAGE" "$(secs "$T_STOP" "$LAST_WRITE_DURING")" "$NOPRIM_ROUNDS" "$OUT_ROUNDS" "$READ_ROUNDS" "$OUT_ROUNDS" "$MAXP" "$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_API")" "$(secs "$T_STOP" "$T_HEALTHY")" "$(secs "$T_STOP" "$FIRST_WRITE_AFTER")" "$verdict"
  printf 'Times are seconds after the server was stopped. Write unavailability lasts the whole outage plus recovery, by design.\n\n## Checks\n\n| Check | Result |\n|---|---|\n'
  cat "$CHECKS"; cat "$BODY"; } | redact > "$EV_FILE"
"$ROOT_DIR/tests/l2-summary.sh"
log "RESULT L2 api-outage: $verdict -> docs/evidence/L2/api-outage.md"
[ "$FAILS" -eq 0 ]

content.text:
L2 passes its gate: all five modes passed 3 runs each, every RTO is under 30 s, and no acknowledged write was lost. The optional API-outage scenario is the exception. It ran, and the cluster recovered by itself to a healthy leader on timeline 25, but the script died both times before writing results, so I have no measurements from it. Per your rule I stopped there.

## Gate checklist

| Item | Result |
|---|---|
| Step 0: `docker exec … true` disclosed in `L1-replication-history.md` (hand-maintained, linked from the generated file) | Done |
| Probe Job writes through `pg-rw` every 500 ms, 2 s connect timeout, logs every acknowledged commit | PASS |
| RTO measured as fault to first write acknowledged by the new primary; RPO as acknowledged rows missing on it | PASS, 0 missing in all 15 runs |
| Never more than one member out of recovery in any 500 ms sample (members asked directly) | PASS, all runs |
| No acknowledged write on the old primary after the new primary's first | PASS, all runs |
| Old primary rejoins on the new timeline, confirmed from the new primary's own replication view | PASS, all runs |
| Sync standby restored after each run | PASS, all runs |
| `failover-pod`, `failover-node`, `failover-storage`, 3 runs each | PASS |
| `test-split-brain`: old primary stops acknowledging before a new leader takes the lock | PASS, 3 runs |
| `make switchover TO=pg-N`, RTO measured the same way | PASS, 3 runs |
| Results in `docs/evidence/L2-failover.md`, with details per mode in `docs/evidence/L2/` | Done |
| Optional: API outage (`make test-api-outage`) | Not measured |

## RTO per failure mode

| Mode | RTO runs (s) | Min to max (s) | RPO | Rejoin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pod deleted | 3.15, 3.08, 3.88 | 3.1–3.9 | 0 | restart only ×2, `pg_rewind` ×1 |
| Node stopped | 21.91, 22.62, 23.35 | 21.9–23.4 | 0 | `pg_rewind` ×3 |
| Storage unavailable | 2.44, 1.79, 3.94 | 1.8–3.9 | 0 | `pg_rewind` ×3 |
| Split-brain (cut from API only) | 20.80, 22.68, 19.82 | 19.8–22.7 | 0 | restart only ×3 |
| Planned switchover | 2.54, 1.83, 2.60 | 1.8–2.6 | 0 | restart only ×2, `pg_rewind` ×1 |

No run needed a full re-clone.

**Split-brain timing:** in the three runs, the isolated primary decided to demote 7.2–7.6 s after its last lock renewal, inside the 13 s bound. Postgres had stopped by 7.4–8.0 s, inside the 20 s budget. Its last acknowledged write came 6.9–7.4 s after the renewal. The new leader took the lock about 21.5 s after it, just past the 20 s TTL.

**Node stop sets the worst case.** The dead primary can't release its lock, so a replica must wait for the 20 s expiry. That puts node failure at about 22–23 s. Nothing was retuned to get there.

**Things that work differently from the brief:**
- **Pod mode** uses a normal `kubectl delete pod`, so Patroni hands over cleanly. An abrupt crash is what the node mode covers. A forced delete risks two Postgres processes on one data directory, so I didn't use it.
- **Storage mode** first tried a read-only remount, which Linux refused because Postgres holds files open for writing. The fault instead unmounts the volume inside the primary's container and kills the Postgres server process (the postmaster). Patroni's log proves the volume was gone: "released leader key voluntarily as data dir empty". The limits:
  - The data stays intact, so this is not a lost or corrupted disk.
  - The kill stands in for a real disk's I/O error.
  - A hung disk is not shown.
- **Split-brain** isolates the primary with an iptables rule on its node, not a NetworkPolicy. A NetworkPolicy would likely let Patroni's already-open connections to the API through. I didn't test that.
- **Switchover** uses `kubectl port-forward` plus `curl`. Patroni rejects the POST through the API server proxy with HTTP 411, because the proxy drops the `Content-Length` header.

**Time:** about 62 minutes (18:03–19:05 UTC) against the 3 h box. The harness needed several fixes along the way, all recorded in the evidence. One wrong field made an early pod run report 0.17 s, and was fixed before any recorded run.

**API outage, in more detail:** the first attempt hung because the test client pod lives on the server node and didn't survive its restart. The second attempt died while writing the report, on an unguarded pipe. I applied a one-line fix for the second failure but have not rerun it.

## What changes L3

1. **Adding archiving restarts every pod in turn, and moves the leader.** That's the L1 finding again, and L3 will trigger it. Deploy the archiving config before any measurement, not during one.
2. **The old primary often had unacknowledged WAL past the failover point.** That's what `pg_rewind` repaired in node, storage and some pod runs. With archiving on, it may push segments from the abandoned timeline, so R4.6 (backup after failover) should check that archiving stays healthy after node and storage faults.
3. **Garage now matters during failover.** Archiving plus `restore_command` let `pg_rewind` and lagging replicas fetch older WAL from Garage. The L0 watch item (a Garage restart while clients are running) becomes relevant here.
4. **Anything that POSTs to Patroni must avoid the API server proxy.** Backup Jobs should use the in-cluster address or a port-forward. Read-only calls through the proxy still work.
5. **Patroni's REST API is still unauthenticated.** Switchover depends on it until L6.

The cluster is healthy (leader `pg-1`, sync standby `pg-0`), test Jobs and pods are cleaned up, a scan found no credential values in the repo, and nothing is committed.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - k3d with k3s v1.35.10: 1 tainted server and 3 agents. Patroni 4.1.5 uses the Kubernetes DCS with `use_endpoints`, and `scope: pg-rw`, so the leader lock lives in the `pg-rw` Endpoints annotations (leader, renewTime, acquireTime).
